# Snapchat
> Snapchat is a social platform for chatting, sharing Snaps and Stories, exploring Spotlight, and creating with AR Lenses.

Snapchat combines messaging, camera-based creation, public content discovery, augmented reality, and business tools across consumer and advertiser experiences. This guide highlights the main product, support, privacy, advertising, and AR development resources across Snapchat and related Snap properties.

## Core Product
- [Snapchat Home](https://www.snapchat.com/): Main entry point for Snapchat features, downloads, and product overview.
- [Chat on Web](https://www.snapchat.com/web?ref=web_nav_chat_icon): Browser-based Snapchat chat experience for messaging and calling.
- [Download Snapchat](https://www.snapchat.com/download/): Download links and setup options for Snapchat on supported devices.
- [Snapchat+](https://www.snapchat.com/plus): Subscription offering with exclusive, experimental, and early-access Snapchat features.
- [Accounts](https://accounts.snapchat.com/): Account management portal for login, settings, and account-related actions.

## Content and Discovery
- [Stories](https://www.snapchat.com/discover): Discover Stories from creators, publishers, and the Snapchat community.
- [Spotlight](https://www.snapchat.com/spotlight): Short-form entertainment feed featuring user-generated Snapchat videos.
- [Lens Explorer](https://link.snapchat.com/lens_explorer/category): Browse AR Lenses by category for Snapchat camera experiences.
- [Public Profiles for Business](https://forbusiness.snapchat.com/public-profiles): Overview of business public profiles for audience presence on Snapchat.

## Support and Help
- [Snapchat Support](https://help.snapchat.com): Help center for Snapchat features, troubleshooting, and account assistance.
- [Privacy Choices Help](https://help.snapchat.com/hc/articles/11399265637012?utm_source=snapchat_com&utm_medium=global_footer&utm_campaign=privacy_choices): Guidance for managing privacy-related choices and controls.
- [Business Support](https://businesshelp.snapchat.com): Help center for advertisers, business accounts, and campaign support.
- [Accounts Portal](https://accounts.snapchat.com/): Self-service destination for account access and management tasks.

## Privacy, Safety, and Policies
- [Privacy and Safety](https://values.snap.com): Snap’s hub for privacy, safety, transparency, and policy information.
- [Privacy Policy](https://snap.com/privacy/privacy-policy): Official privacy policy describing data collection, use, and sharing practices.
- [Cookie Policy](https://snap.com/en-US/cookie-policy): Information about cookies and similar technologies used by Snap.
- [Consumer Health Privacy](https://values.snap.com/privacy/privacy-policy/chd-privacy-policy): Consumer health data privacy disclosures and related policy details.

## Advertising and Business
- [Snap for Business](https://forbusiness.snapchat.com): Business marketing hub for advertising solutions and Snapchat audience reach.
- [Ads Manager](https://ads.snapchat.com): Platform for creating, managing, and measuring Snapchat ad campaigns.
- [Snap Publisher](https://snappublisher.snapchat.com): Creative tool for building and publishing ad assets for Snapchat.
- [Public Profiles for Business](https://forbusiness.snapchat.com/public-profiles): Business profile product for organic presence and customer engagement.
- [Business Help Center](https://businesshelp.snapchat.com): Support documentation for advertisers and business tools.

## AR and Creative Tools
- [Snap AR](https://ar.snap.com): Snap’s augmented reality platform for developers, creators, and businesses.
- [Lens Explorer](https://link.snapchat.com/lens_explorer/category): Public catalog of Snapchat Lenses across multiple categories.
- [Snap Publisher](https://snappublisher.snapchat.com): Tool for producing creative assets used in Snapchat campaigns.

## Account and Access
- [Accounts](https://accounts.snapchat.com): Central account portal for authentication and account management.
- [Chat on Web](https://www.snapchat.com/web?ref=web_nav_chat_icon): Access Snapchat conversations and communication features from a desktop browser.
- [Download Snapchat](https://www.snapchat.com/download/): Install Snapchat mobile apps and access supported download options.

## Related Snap Properties
- [Snap Privacy Policy](https://snap.com/privacy/privacy-policy): Company-wide privacy documentation for Snap services.
- [Snap Cookie Policy](https://snap.com/en-US/cookie-policy): Company-wide cookie usage policy for Snap websites and services.
- [Values by Snap](https://values.snap.com): Broader Snap resource covering safety, privacy, and responsible platform practices.
